ateles.title: Agent harnesses
ateles.intro: A capable working environment helps an agent carry out meaningful tasks.
ateles.takeaway: Keep the environment. Add the operating contract.
ateles.relationship: Ateles can organize work performed through harnesses; the distinction is the continuing responsibility and authority model, not a claim that harnesses lack controls.
ateles.visualAlt: A single cloth contributor advances a marked work packet within its bounded work area.
ateles.strength: Working environments with tools, instructions, project context and controls for carrying out tasks.
ateles.question: What continuing responsibility and authority contract should the agent environment serve?

offerings.name: Claude Code
offerings.summary: Agentic coding environment, project memory and extensibility.

offerings.name: Codex
offerings.summary: Coding agent available through terminal, editor and app surfaces.

offerings.name: Cursor
offerings.summary: Coding agent with codebase tools, rules, checkpoints and project coordination.

offerings.name: OpenCode
offerings.summary: A coding agent with terminal, desktop and editor surfaces and project instructions.

ateles.title: Workflow and agent frameworks
ateles.intro: Execution frameworks help developers define and coordinate agent contributions.
ateles.relationship: A framework can implement substantial governance. Ateles supplies the organizational design around purpose, responsibility and authority.
ateles.visualAlt: Distinct woven contributor stations join a defined ribbon route around one work packet.
ateles.strength: Explicit execution and coordination mechanisms, including persistence, recovery and human intervention.
ateles.question: Which organizational purpose, responsibilities and authority should these flows implement?

offerings.name: LangGraph
offerings.summary: Graph execution with checkpointed and cross-thread state.

offerings.name: CrewAI Flows
offerings.summary: Structured flows with state persistence, resumption and forking.

offerings.name: AutoGen AgentChat
offerings.summary: Multi-agent applications, teams and predefined coordination patterns.

offerings.name: Temporal
offerings.summary: Durable execution and recovery after crashes or infrastructure interruptions.

neotoma.title: Session, project and platform memory
neotoma.intro: Remembered context inside the environment where you already work.
neotoma.relationship: Use tool-native continuity where it fits. Add Neotoma when a shared structured record matters across tools.
neotoma.visualAlt: Distinct paper bundles contain remembered working context in separate tool-specific enclosures.
neotoma.strength: Convenient continuity and relevant context inside the environment where you already work.
neotoma.question: Which facts need an explicit history and a common basis across your tools?

offerings.name: Claude memory
offerings.summary: Topic memory, project memory, chat search, review/edit controls and data export.

offerings.name: ChatGPT Memory and Projects
offerings.summary: Remembered context and project-scoped chats, files and instructions; controls vary by account and plan.

offerings.name: Claude Code memory
offerings.summary: Project instructions and auto memory carry working context between coding sessions.

offerings.name: Cursor Rules
offerings.summary: Reusable project, user and team instructions; instruction delivery is distinct from a structured factual record.

neotoma.title: Files and document retrieval
neotoma.intro: Keep readable sources and retrieve the passages relevant to a task.
neotoma.takeaway: Keep the sources. Make the current basis explicit.
neotoma.relationship: Source files and retrieval can remain valuable alongside Neotoma’s structured records and field histories.
neotoma.visualAlt: Paper source sheets and excerpts are indexed into readable grouped passages.
neotoma.strength: Readable source material and retrieval of useful passages from a larger corpus.
neotoma.question: When two sources disagree, where does the corrected fact and its lineage live?

offerings.name: Claude memory tool
offerings.summary: Client-controlled persistent file operations across conversations.

offerings.name: LlamaIndex RAG
offerings.summary: Document loading, indexing and retrieval; nodes retain metadata and relationships.

offerings.name: AutoGen Memory and RAG
offerings.summary: A memory protocol with vector stores and document indexing/retrieval examples.

neotoma.title: Memory services and stateful agents
neotoma.intro: Purpose-built memory systems offer different persistence, graph and recall contracts.
neotoma.relationship: Inspect the configured service rather than assuming every memory product behaves alike. Neotoma offers a structured, revisable context record.
neotoma.visualAlt: A stable collection of distinct paper records connects to several shaped reader tabs.
neotoma.strength: Purpose-built memory and context infrastructure for agent applications.
neotoma.question: What does the service preserve, how are corrections resolved, and what can you inspect or reconstruct?

offerings.name: Mem0
offerings.summary: Long-term memory across sessions, tools and runs, with managed and self-hosted paths.

offerings.name: Zep
offerings.summary: Governed shared context from business data, documents and conversations in temporal graphs.

offerings.name: Letta
offerings.summary: Persisted agent state and editable memory blocks, including shared blocks.

neotoma.title: Workflow and custom state
neotoma.intro: Build persistence around the state model your application needs.
neotoma.takeaway: Choose what you want to own.
neotoma.relationship: Application state can implement substantial context behavior. Neotoma supplies a maintained record layer instead of requiring you to build that layer yourself.
neotoma.visualAlt: Paper fields sit in a deliberately bounded custom record structure with separate retained amendments.
neotoma.strength: Application-defined state, persistence and transactional storage that you can shape for a particular workflow.
neotoma.question: Which history, identity, correction and access contracts will your application supply?

offerings.name: LangGraph persistence
offerings.summary: Checkpoints within a thread and stores across threads for application-defined information.

offerings.name: SQLite
offerings.summary: Local transactional storage for an application-defined data model.

offerings.name: PostgreSQL
offerings.summary: Transactional database infrastructure with concurrency controls.
